subject: ES-ENAS status: edge-mode suite running, controller swap cost us
body:
Hi Anders, Santiago,

Status for the Mar 27 milestone. The edge-mode benchmark suite is running end to end on Rosa's gRPC layer - 2,000 workers, stable for 72-hour runs, aggregator restarts are clean. On our three locomotion benchmarks, edge-mode search (aggregate_edges space) finds policies matching the dense-baseline reward with 64% fewer edges on average. That's the compact-controller story we wanted.

The honest part: swapping the non-open-sourced proposal library for our internal evolutionary controller took three weeks, not two. Suggest/feedback semantics were easy; matching the weight-sharing behavior during topology updates was not - early runs regressed reward by ~15% until we fixed update ordering.

Risk for the partition-mode milestone: partition search spaces are larger and my current runs are converging slowly. May need to cap v1 at edge mode and document partitions as experimental. Will have a firm recommendation by Apr 10.

Freya
